entries.title: Logout
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/auth/logout`

Server-side logout. Revokes all of the user's refresh tokens via Cognito GlobalSignOut. The frontend must also clear its locally cached tokens.

## Request
- Auth required.
- No path params, query params, or body.

## Responses

**200 — logged out**
```json
{ "success": true, "data": {}, "error": "" }
```

**500 — Cognito GlobalSignOut failed**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Logout failed" }
```

entries.title: Switch Org
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/auth/switch-org`

Switches the user's **default** org by updating the Cognito `custom:current_org_id` attribute. That claim is the *fallback* org context — per-request context is normally set by the **`X-Org-Id`** header (the frontend derives it from the URL slug, so two tabs can sit in different orgs). Refresh the session after switching so the new claim is picked up where the header is absent (auth flows, welcome, invite accept).

## Request
- Auth required.
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `orgId` | yes | string; user must be a member of this org |

## Responses

**200 — switched** (`mustRefreshToken` tells the client to refresh tokens)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "orgId": "org-123", "mustRefreshToken": true },
  "error": ""
}
```

**400 — validation**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "orgId is required" }
```

**403 — not a member of the target org** (or the org was cancelled)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Not a member of the target organization" }
```

**500 — Cognito AdminUpdateUserAttributes failed**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Org switch failed" }
```

entries.title: Billing API
entries.docs:
Per-seat subscriptions for an org. **Owner/admin only** (except the webhook).
Product rules → `Guide/guide-billing.md`. All routes are under `/api/v1/billing`
and need `Authorization` + `X-Org-Id` (except the webhook, which is public + signed).

These routes use `attachOrgContext` (NOT the read-only write-gate) on purpose —
paying, reactivating, and cancelling must work while the org is read-only.

Our prices/amounts are **whole rupees** (`price_per_seat_inr`, `amount_due_inr`). Razorpay-sourced amounts (invoices, checkout `amount`) are in **paise** (×100) — that conversion happens at the Razorpay boundary only.

---

## GET /api/v1/billing

Billing summary for the current org. Lazily creates the trial row if missing.

**200**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "billing": {
      "status": "trialing",
      "gate_status": "trial",
      "billing_mode": "recurring",
      "auto_renew": true,
      "plan_name": "Standard",
      "price_per_seat_inr": 50,
      "currency": "INR",
      "active_seats": 5,
      "peak_seats": 5,
      "amount_due_inr": 250,
      "trial_started_at": "2026-06-09T00:00:00.000Z",
      "trial_ends_at": "2026-07-09T00:00:00.000Z",
      "current_period_end": null,
      "canceled_at": null,
      "provider_live": false,
      "razorpay_key_id": null
    }
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
- `status` — detailed: `trialing` | `active` | `past_due` | `canceled`.
- `gate_status` — org read-only gate: `trial` | `active` | `suspended` | `cancelled`.
- `trial_started_at` / `trial_ends_at` — trial window bounds (start = org creation; 30-day span). Null if never trialed. UI renders the range + days-left and, for a subscribe-during-trial, the deferred first-charge date.
- `provider_live` — `false` ⇒ NoOp (test) provider; subscribing activates instantly.

**403** — caller isn't owner/admin. **500** — `Could not load billing`.

---

## GET /api/v1/billing/invoices

Past invoices/receipts for the org's recurring subscription, newest first. Each
carries a hosted, downloadable PDF link (`downloadUrl`). Empty array when there's
no live recurring subscription or the provider has none (NoOp/dev, or one-time
orders — Razorpay only auto-generates invoices for subscriptions).

**200**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "invoices": [
      {
        "id": "inv_Xxx",
        "date": "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "amountCents": 25000,
        "currency": "INR",
        "status": "paid",
        "downloadUrl": "https://rzp.io/i/xxxx"
      }
    ]
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
**403** — not owner/admin. **500** — `Could not load invoices`.

---

## POST /api/v1/billing/subscribe

Start a paid subscription (or reactivate a read-only org).

Body: `{ "mode": "recurring" | "one_time" }`

**200** — returns what's needed to open Razorpay checkout. On the NoOp provider
`activated` is `true` (no checkout needed).
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "checkout": {
      "mode": "recurring",
      "activated": false,
      "razorpayKeyId": "rzp_test_xxx",
      "subscriptionId": "sub_Xxx",
      "orderId": null,
      "amountCents": 25000,
      "currency": "INR"
    }
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
- `recurring` → open checkout with `subscription_id`.
- `one_time`  → open checkout with `order_id` + `amount`.

**400** — `mode must be 'recurring' or 'one_time'`. **502** — provider/config error.

---

## POST /api/v1/billing/confirm

Confirm a completed checkout (or reactivate). The frontend calls this from the
Razorpay success handler.

Body (one-time): `{ "orderId", "paymentId", "signature" }`
Body (recurring): `{ "subscriptionId", "paymentId", "signature" }`

For `one_time` the order-payment signature is HMAC-verified before activation.
**200** — returns the updated `billing` summary. **400** — `Payment could not be verified`.

---

## POST /api/v1/billing/cancel

Cancel the subscription. **OTP-gated** — first call `POST /api/v1/otp/request`
with `{ "action": "cancel_subscription", "targetId": "<org id>" }`, then pass the
emailed code here. End-of-period by default (full access through
`current_period_end`, then read-only); `"immediate": true` flips to read-only now.

> **Single off-switch.** There is no separate "auto-renew toggle" / "resume" —
> cancel is the only way to stop, and coming back is a fresh `POST /billing/subscribe`
> (a cancelled Razorpay mandate can't be revived; the new charge is scheduled at
> the current period end, so no gap or double-bill).

**Netflix-style charge handling** (transparent to the caller — always a clean 200):
- **First charge already taken** (live billing cycle) → Razorpay cancel-at-period-end. The current paid month stands (no refund); access runs to `current_period_end`.
- **First charge NOT taken yet** (still on free trial, or charge deferred to period end) → the mandate is cancelled **immediately** on Razorpay so the scheduled charge never fires (**₹0 billed**), while local access is retained until `current_period_end`. The trial/period sweep flips the org read-only at the boundary.

Body: `{ "code": "123456", "immediate": false }`
**200** — updated `billing` summary (both cases above).
**400/401** — OTP missing / wrong / expired (codes from the OTP gate).
**502** — `Could not cancel with the payment provider: <reason>` — the provider refused the cancel; the real reason is included.

---

## POST /api/v1/billing/webhook

**Public**, provider-to-server. Mounted before `express.json` with a raw body so
the `x-razorpay-signature` HMAC (keyed by `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) can be
verified. Drives `subscription.activated/charged/halted/cancelled` → state sync.

**200** on any verified event (even ignored ones, so the provider doesn't retry).
**400** — missing raw body / signature / bad JSON. **401** — invalid signature.
entries.curl:
All routes need `Authorization` + `X-Org-Id` (owner/admin), except the webhook.

```bash
# Summary
curl "{{base_url}}/api/v1/billing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}"

# Invoices / receipts (download links)
curl "{{base_url}}/api/v1/billing/invoices" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}"

# Subscribe — recurring (auto-renew) or one_time
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/billing/subscribe" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "mode": "recurring" }'

# Confirm a completed checkout (one-time shown; recurring sends subscriptionId)
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/billing/confirm" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "orderId": "order_Xxx", "paymentId": "pay_Xxx", "signature": "hex..." }'

# Cancel — OTP-gated. First request a code:
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/otp/request" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "action": "cancel_subscription", "targetId": "{{org_id}}" }'
# ...then pass the emailed code:
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/billing/cancel" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "code": "123456", "immediate": false }'

# Webhook (Razorpay → server). Signature is computed by Razorpay; shown for shape only.
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/billing/webhook" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-razorpay-signature: <hmac-sha256-of-raw-body>" \
  -d '{ "event": "subscription.activated", "payload": { "subscription": { "entity": { "id": "sub_Xxx", "current_end": 1751990400 } } } }'
```

entries.title: Register Device (push)
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/devices`

Registers (or refreshes) a mobile **FCM device token** so the user receives push notifications on that device. The mobile app calls this on login and whenever Firebase issues/rotates its token.

The token is globally unique: re-registering an existing token simply moves it to the current user and refreshes its `last_seen_at` (handles a shared device / re-login cleanly). Dead tokens are pruned automatically by the backend when FCM reports them on a later send — the app does not need to clean up after an uninstall.

Push mirrors the in-app feed: every notification that writes a bell row also fans out to the user's registered devices. It is a no-op (silently skipped) until the backend has `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` configured.

## Request
- Auth required (`authMiddleware` only). The device belongs to the **user**, not an org — no `X-Org-Id` header.
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `token` | yes | the FCM registration token from the app (1–4096 chars) |
| `platform` | yes | one of `ios`, `android`, `web` |

## Responses

**200 — registered**
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "registered": true }, "error": "" }
```

**400 — validation**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "A valid device token is required" }
```
Other 400: `platform must be one of: ios, android, web`.

**500 — DB error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not register device" }
```
entries.curl:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/devices" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "token": "{{fcm_device_token}}", "platform": "android" }'
```

Call on login and on every FCM token refresh. Registering the same token again is safe — it just refreshes the record.

entries.title: Unregister Device (push)
entries.docs:
`DELETE /api/v1/devices`

Removes a device token so the user stops receiving push on that device. The app calls this on **logout** (or when the user disables push in settings). Only the caller's own token is removed.

Not strictly required for uninstalls — the backend prunes tokens that FCM reports as dead on the next send — but calling it on an explicit logout is the clean path.

## Request
- Auth required (`authMiddleware` only). No `X-Org-Id` header.
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `token` | yes | the FCM registration token to remove |

## Responses

**200 — done** (`removed` is `false` if the token wasn't registered to this user)
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "removed": true }, "error": "" }
```

**400 — validation**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "A device token is required" }
```

**500 — DB error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not unregister device" }
```
entries.curl:
```bash
curl -X DELETE "{{base_url}}/api/v1/devices" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "token": "{{fcm_device_token}}" }'
```

Call on logout / when the user turns push off.

entries.title: Submit Feedback
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/feedback`

Stores one feedback submission (the in-app feedback modal) **and** emails it to
support. Auth only — **no org context required**, so it works from any page. The
caller's current org (if any) is attached automatically for context.

## Request
- Auth required (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). No `X-Org-Id` needed.
- Rate limit: **5 / hour per IP** (each submit writes a row + sends an email).
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `title` | yes | 1–150 chars |
| `body`  | yes | 5–5000 chars |

## Responses

**201 — submitted**
```json
{ "success": true, "data": {}, "error": "" }
```

**400 — validation**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Title is required (max 150 characters)" }
```
Other 400: `Please write a bit more (5-5000 characters)`.

**429 — rate limited** · **500 — db error** (`Could not submit feedback`).

> The support email is best-effort: if SES fails, the row is still saved and the
> request still returns 201 (the DB is the source of truth). Destination =
> destination = `SUPPORT_EMAIL` (default `support@rai.novetum.com`).
entries.curl:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/feedback" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "title": "Love the board view", "body": "Could we get swimlanes by assignee?" }'
```

No `X-Org-Id` needed. Stores the row + emails support.

entries.title: Accept Invite
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/invites/accept`

Accepts an invite for the logged-in user. The invite's email must match the caller's email. On success the new org is set as current in Cognito.

## Request
- Auth required. Caller's email must match the invite's `invited_email`.
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `token` | yes | the invite token from the accept link |

## Responses

**200 — accepted**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "org": { "id": "1", "name": "Acme Corp", "slug": "acme" },
    "mustRefreshToken": true
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
`mustRefreshToken` is `true` when the org was set as current in Cognito (frontend should refresh the token). It is `false` if that best-effort step failed, or if the org row vanished after commit (in which case `org` is `{ "id": "<orgId>", "name": "", "slug": "" }`).

**400 — missing token**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Invite token is required" }
```

**404 — invalid link**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Invite link is invalid" }
```

**403 — wrong account**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "This invite was sent to newhire@acme.com. Sign in with that email to accept." }
```

**410 — invite no longer usable** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "This invite has already been used" }
```
Other 410: `This invite has been revoked - ask for a new one`, `This invite has expired - ask for a new one`.

**500 — server error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not accept invite" }
```

entries.title: Create Invite
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/orgs/:id/invites`

Invites an email to the org with a role. Inserts the invite (superseding any prior live invite for the same email) and sends the invite email.

## Request
- Auth required. Caller must be `owner`, `admin`, or `project_manager` in the org.
- Path: `:id` — org id
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `email` | yes | valid email; trimmed + lowercased |
| `role` | yes | `admin` \| `project_manager` \| `user` (never `owner`) |

## Responses

**201 — created**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "invite": {
      "id": "018f...",
      "invited_email": "newhire@acme.com",
      "role": "user",
      "expires_at": "2026-06-09T14:00:00.000Z"
    }
  },
  "error": ""
}
```

**400 — validation** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Valid email is required" }
```
Other 400: `Role must be admin, project_manager, or user`.

**403 — no permission**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "You do not have permission to invite members" }
```

**409 — already a member**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "newhire@acme.com is already a member of this org" }
```

**500 — server error** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not verify org membership" }
```
Other 500: `Could not verify invitee status`, `Could not create invite`.

**502 — email delivery failed** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Invite created but email delivery failed - please try again" }
```
If the address is unverified in the SES sandbox: `Couldn't send email to <email> - recipient not verified in SES sandbox. Verify the address in AWS Console first.` (the invite row is rolled back in both cases).

entries.title: List Pending Invites
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/orgs/:id/invites`

Lists the org's pending (not used, not revoked, not expired) invites, newest first. Powers the Team page "Pending invites" list.

## Request
- Auth required. Caller must be `owner`, `admin`, or `project_manager` in the org.
- Path: `:id` — org id

## Responses

**200 — OK**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "invites": [
      {
        "id": "018f...",
        "invited_email": "newhire@acme.com",
        "role": "user",
        "invited_by_name": "Jane Doe",
        "invited_by_email": "jane@acme.com",
        "expires_at": "2026-06-09T14:00:00.000Z",
        "created_at": "2026-06-02T14:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ]
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
`invites` is `[]` when there are none. `invited_by_name` may be `null`.

**403 — no permission**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Forbidden" }
```

**500 — server error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not load pending invites" }
```

entries.title: Preview Invite
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/invites/preview/:token`

Public, no auth. Returns the public-safe invite details (org name, role, invited email, lifecycle state) for the "Join \<org\>?" confirm card before the user signs in.

## Request
- Public — no token required.
- Path: `:token` — the invite token from the accept link

## Responses

**200 — OK**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "org_name": "Acme Corp",
    "role": "user",
    "invited_email": "newhire@acme.com",
    "state": "pending",
    "expires_at": "2026-06-09T14:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
`state` is one of `pending` \| `used` \| `revoked` \| `expired`.

**400 — token missing**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Token is required" }
```

**404 — not found** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Invite link is invalid" }
```
Other 404: `Organization no longer exists`.
entries.curl:
```bash
curl "{{base_url}}/api/v1/invites/preview/<invite-token-from-the-link>"
```

No token needed — this route is public.

entries.title: Revoke Invite
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/invites/:id/revoke`

Revokes a pending invite. Caller's role is checked against the invite's own org.

## Request
- Auth required. Caller must be `owner`, `admin`, or `project_manager` in the invite's org.
- Path: `:id` — invite id

## Responses

**200 — revoked**
```json
{ "success": true, "data": {}, "error": "" }
```

**404 — not found**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Invite not found" }
```

**403 — no permission**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Forbidden" }
```

**500 — server error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not revoke invite" }
```

entries.title: Get Me
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/me`

Current user profile plus all org memberships. No org context required.

## Request
- Auth required. No path/query params.

## Responses

**200 — OK**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "c3d4e5f6-...",
      "email": "jane@acme.com",
      "emailVerified": true,
      "name": "Jane Doe",
      "currentOrgId": "8f2a..."
    },
    "memberships": [
      {
        "org_id": "8f2a...",
        "org_name": "Acme Corp",
        "org_slug": "acme",
        "subscription_status": "active",
        "discoverable": true,
        "role": "admin",
        "role_label": "Admin"
      }
    ]
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
`name` and `currentOrgId` may be `null`. `memberships` is `[]` when the user belongs to no org. `subscription_status` is `trial` \| `active` \| `suspended` \| `cancelled`; `role` is `owner` \| `admin` \| `project_manager` \| `user`; `role_label` may be `null`.

**401 — auth** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Authentication required" }
```
Other 401s: `Invalid or expired token`, `Token missing email claim`.

**500 — auth sync / db error** (`Auth sync failed`, `Auth link failed`)

entries.title: My Tickets
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/me/tickets`

All tickets assigned to the caller in the current org, filtered by what they can see. Owners/admins see org-wide; others see only their accessible projects.

## Request
- Auth required. **Org context required** via the `X-Org-Id` header — 403 otherwise.
- No path/query params.

## Responses

**200 — OK** (array of work items)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "ticket": {
        "id": "13",
        "key": "PROJ-13",
        "title": "Fix login redirect loop",
        "description": "Users bounce between /login and /dashboard",
        "type": "bug",
        "status": "todo",
        "priority": "high",
        "assignee": null,
        "reporter": null,
        "parentKey": null,
        "subTicketKeys": [],
        "comments": [],
        "sprintId": "3",
        "projectId": "1",
        "createdAt": "2026-06-02T14:00:00.000Z",
        "updatedAt": "2026-06-02T14:00:00.000Z",
        "assigneeName": "Jane Doe",
        "reporterName": "John Smith",
        "isPinned": false
      },
      "project": {
        "id": "1",
        "name": "Platform",
        "key": "PROJ",
        "description": null,
        "archived": false,
        "visibility": "team",
        "ticketCount": 0,
        "memberCount": 0,
```

```json
{
```

entries.title: List Notifications
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/notifications`

The current user's notification feed (the bell/inbox), newest first. **User-scoped, not org-scoped** — one cross-org feed; no `X-Org-Id` header needed. Each row carries its org slug so the client can build the deep-link.

## Request
- Auth required.
- Query params (optional):
  - `limit` — page size, 1–50 (default 20).
  - `before` — return rows with `id <` this value (keyset pagination; pass the previous page's `nextBefore`).

## Responses

**200 — OK**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": 412,
        "type": "ticket_assigned",
        "title": "Jane Doe assigned you Fix login redirect",
        "link": "/projects/3/tickets/87",
        "read_at": null,
        "created_at": "2026-06-08T10:12:00.000Z",
        "org_id": "8f2a...",
        "org_slug": "acme",
        "org_name": "Acme Corp"
      }
    ],
    "unreadCount": 4,
    "nextBefore": 401
  },
  "error": ""
}
```
- `link` is relative to the org — build the full path as `/orgs/{org_slug}{link}`. May be `null` (non-navigable notice).
- `read_at` is `null` until read.
- `nextBefore` is the `id` to pass as `before` for the next page, or `null` when there are no more rows.

**401 — auth**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Authentication required" }
```

**500 — db error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not load notifications" }
```

```bash
curl "{{base_url}}/api/v1/notifications?limit=20" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
```

```bash

  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
```

entries.title: Delete Org
entries.docs:
`DELETE /api/v1/orgs/:id`

Owner-only **soft delete** (recycle bin). Stamps `deleted_at` instead of wiping the row, so the org and all its data vanish from the app immediately but stay recoverable for **30 days** via [`POST /api/v1/orgs/:id/restore`](./restore%20-%20docs.md). A purge job hard-deletes (CASCADE) orgs past the window. Idempotent — deleting an already-deleted org returns 404. **OTP-gated** — the caller first requests a code via [`POST /api/v1/otp/request`](../otp-api/request%20-%20docs.md) (`action: "delete_org"`, `targetId: <org id>`), then passes it as `otpCode`.

## Request
- Auth required. Caller must be the org owner.
- Path: `:id` — org id
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `otpCode` | yes | 6-digit code from `POST /api/v1/otp/request` (action `delete_org`, target = this org id) |

## Responses

**200 — soft-deleted** (`restoreWindowDays` tells the client how long it stays recoverable)
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "restoreWindowDays": 30 }, "error": "" }
```

**400 — missing/invalid code**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "A 6-digit verification code is required" }
```

**401 — OTP rejected** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Incorrect verification code" }
```
Other 401s: `Your verification code has expired — request a new one`, `Too many incorrect attempts — request a new code`, `No active code — request a verification code first`.

**403 — not owner** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Forbidden" }
```
Other 403s: `Only the owner can delete this organization`.

**404 — not found or already deleted**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Organization not found" }
```

**500 — db error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not delete organization" }
```

entries.title: List Deleted Orgs (recycle bin)
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/orgs/deleted`

The caller's **recently deleted** orgs — soft-deleted, owned by the caller, and still inside the 30-day recovery window. Powers the "Recently deleted" restore list on the create-org / welcome screen. Only the **owner** of a deleted org sees it here; other former members just see it disappear.

Static path — registered before the `/:id` routes.

## Request
- Auth required.
- No path params, no body.

## Responses

**200 — list** (`restore_until` = `deleted_at` + 30 days, for the "X days left" countdown; empty array is the normal case)

The `subscription_status` / `trial_ends_at` / `current_period_end` fields are a **billing snapshot** — billing keeps running while an org is soft-deleted (v2 doesn't pause it), so the UI can show how much trial/subscription time is left before the owner restores. All three are `null` for an org with no live subscription row.
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "orgs": [
      {
        "id": "018f-org-id",
        "name": "Acme Corp",
        "slug": "acme",
        "deleted_at": "2026-06-08T12:00:00.000Z",
        "restore_until": "2026-07-08T12:00:00.000Z",
        "subscription_status": "trialing",
        "trial_ends_at": "2026-07-01T12:00:00.000Z",
        "current_period_end": null
      }
    ]
  },
  "error": ""
}
```

**500 — db error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not load deleted organizations" }
```

  ```json
    "projects": [ { "id": 1, "key": "PROJ", "name": "...", "description": "...", "visibility": "private", "archived": false, "created_at": "..." } ],
    "sprints":  [ { "id": 3, "project_id": 1, "project_key": "PROJ", "name": "Sprint 1", "status": "active", "start_date": "...", "end_date": "...", "goal": "...", "created_at": "..." } ],
  ```

entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/orgs/:id/restore`

Owner-only. Restores a soft-deleted org while it's still inside the 30-day recovery window (clears `deleted_at`, the org reappears everywhere). Counterpart to [`DELETE /api/v1/orgs/:id`](./delete%20-%20docs.md). List restorable orgs with [`GET /api/v1/orgs/deleted`](./deleted%20-%20docs.md).

## Request
- Auth required. Caller must be the org owner. (Ownership is read from the surviving membership rows, so this works even though the org is hidden everywhere else.)
- Path: `:id` — org id
- No body.

## Responses

**200 — restored** (returns the live org row)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "org": {
      "id": "018f-org-id",
```

entries.title: Request Action OTP
entries.docs:
`POST /api/v1/otp/request`

Mints a single-use, 6-digit verification code for a **sensitive action** and emails it to the caller's own verified address. The code is required to execute the action on its own endpoint (delete org / transfer ownership / delete project), which re-verifies it.

The code is bound to the `(caller, action, targetId)` triple — a code minted for one org/project can't authorize another, and a code for `delete_org` can't be replayed on `transfer_ownership`. Requesting a new code for the same triple silently retires the previous one. Codes expire after **10 minutes** and are burned after **3 wrong attempts**.

This endpoint does **not** check whether the caller is allowed to perform the action — that gate lives on the execution endpoint (role + code). Worst case, a user mints a code for something they can't do; it's useless without passing the action endpoint's own authorization.

## Request
- Auth required. The code always goes to `req.user.email` (no recipient field).
- No org header needed (`authMiddleware` only).
- Rate limit: **5 requests / 10 min per IP** (each send is a real email).
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `action` | yes | one of `delete_org`, `transfer_ownership`, `delete_project` |
| `targetId` | yes | the entity the action targets — org id or project id (string) |

## Responses

**200 — code emailed**
```json
{ "success": true, "data": {}, "error": "" }
```

**400 — validation** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Unknown action" }
```
Other 400s: `targetId is required`.

**429 — rate limited**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Too many code requests — please wait a few minutes" }
```

**500 — email send failed**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not send the verification code — please try again" }
```
entries.curl:
```bash
curl -X POST "{{base_url}}/api/v1/otp/request" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "action": "delete_org", "targetId": "018f-org-id" }'
```

The 6-digit code is emailed to your own address. Pass it back as `otpCode` on the matching action endpoint (e.g. `DELETE /api/v1/orgs/:id`).

entries.docs:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/:id/sprints/:sprintId`

Updates sprint fields or transitions its status (start / complete). Returns the updated sprint.

## Request
- Auth required. Org role must be `owner`, `admin`, or `project_manager` (PMs must be a member of the project or the project must be public). Project must not be archived.
- Path: `:id` — project id (number); `:sprintId` — sprint id (number)
- Body (JSON) — send only the fields you want to change:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `name` | non-empty string; trimmed |
| `goal` | free text or `null` |
| `notes` | free text or `null` |
| `startDate` | ISO date string or `null` |
| `endDate` | ISO date string or `null` |
| `status` | `active` (start) or `completed` (finish). Cannot revert to `planned`. |
| `archived` | boolean. Active sprints can't be archived — complete first. |

When `status` is present it takes the status-transition path (the other fields are ignored). `active` requires no other sprint is currently active in the project; completing moves incomplete tickets to the backlog.

## Responses

**200 — updated**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "7",
    "name": "Sprint 12",
    "status": "active",
    "startDate": "2026-06-02T00:00:00.000Z",
    "endDate": "2026-06-16T00:00:00.000Z",

  },
  "error": ""
}
```

**403 — no access / archived**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Cannot modify sprints on an archived project" }
```
Other 403: `You do not have access to this project`.

**404 — not found**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Sprint not found" }
```
Other 404: `Project not found`.

**409 — conflict**
```json

```
Other 409: `A sprint named "Sprint 12" already exists in this project` (on rename).

`POST /api/v1/projects/:id/tickets`

Creates a ticket in a project. Returns the **full** ticket (with sub-tickets + comments).

## Request
- Auth required. Project must not be archived.
- Path: `:id` — project id (number)
- Body (JSON):

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `title` | yes | min 2 characters |
| `type` | yes | `task` \| `bug` \| `story` \| `epic` |
| `priority` | yes | `lowest` \| `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `critical` |
| `status` | no | defaults to `todo` |
| `description` | no | free text |
| `assigneeId` | no | must be a member of this project |
| `sprintId` | no | must belong to this project |
| `parentKey` | no | existing ticket key in this project (e.g. `PROJ-1`) |

### Type-specific fields (Jira parity)

Send only the fields the `type` owns; anything for a different type is ignored. All optional.

| Field | For type | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `epicName` | `epic` | short label, ≤ 60 chars |
| `epicColor` | `epic` | one of `slate, blue, teal, green, amber, orange, red, pink, purple, indigo` |
| `storyPoints` | `story` | integer 0–999 |
| `acceptanceCriteria` | `story` | free text, ≤ 5000 chars |
| `stepsToReproduce` | `bug` | free text, ≤ 5000 chars |
| `environment` | `bug` | ≤ 255 chars |

The response always includes all six (`epicName`, `epicColor`, `storyPoints`, `acceptanceCriteria`, `stepsToReproduce`, `environment`) — `null` when unset or not applicable to the type.

```json
  "data": {

    "reporter": { "id": "c3d4...", "name": "John Smith", "email": "john@acme.com", "role_type": "admin", "role_name": "Admin", "initials": "JS" },

    "projectId": "1",
    "createdAt": "2026-06-02T14:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-06-02T14:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "error": ""
}
```

Other 400s: `Title is required`, `type must be one of: ...`, `priority must be one of: ...`, `Assignee is not a member of this project`, `Sprint does not belong to this project`, `Parent ticket "PROJ-X" not found in this project`, `Invalid sprintId`, `epicColor must be one of: ...`, `storyPoints must be an integer between 0 and 999`.

`GET /api/v1/projects/:id/tickets`

Returns all tickets in a project (board / backlog view). Optional filters narrow the list. This is the lighter list shape — no comments or sub-tickets (use **Get Ticket** for those).

entries.title: Update Ticket
entries.docs:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/:id/tickets/:ticketId`

Partial update of a ticket. Send only the fields you want to change. Returns the **full** ticket. Project must not be archived.

## Request
- Auth required. Project must not be archived.
- Path:
  - `:id` — project id (number)
  - `:ticketId` — ticket id (number)
- Body (JSON) — all optional, but at least one field is required:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `title` | non-empty, min 2 characters |
| `description` | free text, or `null` to clear |
| `type` | `task` \| `bug` \| `story` \| `epic` |
| `priority` | `lowest` \| `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `critical` |
| `status` | `todo` \| `in_progress` \| `in_review` \| `done` |
| `assigneeId` | member of this project, or `null` to unassign |
| `sprintId` | sprint in this project, or `null` to clear |
| `parentKey` | existing ticket key in this project, or `null`/`""` to clear |

### Type-specific fields (Jira parity)

Same fields as Create. `null` clears a field; only fields the **effective type** owns are written (effective type = `type` in this request if changing, else the ticket's current type). Changing `type` auto-clears the previous type's fields.

| Field | For type | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `epicName` | `epic` | ≤ 60 chars, or `null` |
| `epicColor` | `epic` | one of `slate, blue, teal, green, amber, orange, red, pink, purple, indigo` |
| `storyPoints` | `story` | integer 0–999, or `null` |
| `acceptanceCriteria` | `story` | ≤ 5000 chars, or `null` |
| `stepsToReproduce` | `bug` | ≤ 5000 chars, or `null` |
| `environment` | `bug` | ≤ 255 chars, or `null` |

## Responses

**200 — updated** (full ticket — same shape as Get Ticket)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "12",
    "key": "PROJ-12",
    "title": "Fix login redirect loop",
    "description": "Users bounce between /login and /dashboard",
    "type": "bug",
    "status": "done",
    "priority": "high",
    "epicName": null,
    "epicColor": null,
    "storyPoints": null,
    "acceptanceCriteria": null,
    "stepsToReproduce": "1. Open /login\n2. Sign in",
    "environment": "Chrome 120 · Windows 11",
    "assignee": { "id": "a1b2...", "name": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@acme.com", "role_type": "user", "role_name": "Member", "initials": "JD" },
    "reporter": { "id": "c3d4...", "name": "John Smith", "email": "john@acme.com", "role_type": "admin", "role_name": "Admin", "initials": "JS" },
    "parentKey": "PROJ-1",
    "subTicketKeys": [],
    "comments": [],
    "sprintId": "3",
    "projectId": "1",
    "createdAt": "2026-06-01T10:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-06-02T14:30:00.000Z"
  },
  "error": ""
}
```

**400 — validation** (one of these messages)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "No fields to update" }
```
Other 400s: `Invalid id`, `Title cannot be empty`, `Title must be at least 2 characters`, `type must be one of: ...`, `priority must be one of: ...`, `status must be one of: ...`, `Assignee is not a member of this project`, `Invalid sprintId`, `Sprint does not belong to this project`, `Parent ticket "PROJ-X" not found in this project`, `A ticket cannot be its own parent`, `epicColor must be one of: ...`, `storyPoints must be an integer between 0 and 999`, `epicName must be at most 60 characters`, `environment must be at most 255 characters`.

**403 — no access / archived**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Cannot modify tickets in an archived project" }
```
Also `You do not have access to this project`.

**404 — project not found** (`Project not found`) · **404 — ticket not found** (`Ticket not found`)

**500 — db error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Could not update ticket" }
```

overview.setup:
How to read and use these files.

## The values you set

| Placeholder | Meaning | Example |
|-------------|---------|---------|
| `{{base_url}}` | API host + port | `http://localhost:4000` |
| `{{token}}` | Cognito token (ID/access token of the logged-in user) | `<token>` |
| `{{org_id}}` | Active org id — sent as the `X-Org-Id` header on org-scoped routes | `<org_id>` |

Every `* - curl.md` file uses these placeholders and nothing else machine-specific. Set them once, paste, run. (`{{org_id}}` only appears on org-scoped routes — see Conventions below.)

## In Postman
1. Create an Environment (e.g. **Rai local**).
2. Add three variables: `base_url`, `token`, and `org_id`.
3. Import a curl snippet: **Import → Raw text →** paste the curl block → **Send**.
4. Postman fills `{{base_url}}`, `{{token}}`, and `{{org_id}}` from the active environment.

## In a terminal
```bash
export BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000
export TOKEN=<token>        # paste a real Cognito token
export ORG_ID=<org_id>      # the org you're acting in (org-scoped routes)
```
Then in the curl, swap `{{base_url}}` → `$BASE_URL`, `{{token}}` → `$TOKEN`, and `{{org_id}}` → `$ORG_ID`.

## Where the token comes from
v2 auth is **AWS Cognito**. Log in through the frontend, then copy the access token (browser devtools → Application/Storage, or the Network tab on a `/me` call). Paste it as `token`.

## Conventions used everywhere
- **Response envelope** — every response is `{ "success": bool, "data": ..., "error": "" }`.
- **Org context** — org-scoped routes need an **`X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}`** header naming the org you're acting in; it's re-validated against your membership on every call. Routes like health, auth, and `/me` (profile) need no org; `orgs/*` and `invites/*` take the org from the URL path instead.
- **Auth header** — protected routes need `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Files note when a route is public.

## HTTP status codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | Success |
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Bad request / validation error |
| 401 | Not authenticated (missing/invalid token) |
| 403 | Authenticated but not allowed (role / access / archived) |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict (e.g. slug taken, sprint already active) |
| 410 | Gone (invite used / revoked / expired) |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Server error |
| 502 | Upstream failure (e.g. SES email send) |

## Rate limiting
1500 requests per 15 minutes per IP (~100/min). Over the limit returns **429**:
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Too many requests - please try again in 15 minutes" }
```

entries.title: Search Tickets
entries.docs:
`GET /api/v1/search`

Org-scoped, visibility-aware ticket search by title or key (case-insensitive). Key matches rank first, then most-recently-updated. Capped at 20 results.

## Request
- Auth required. Org-scoped — needs the `X-Org-Id` header.
- Query:
  - `q` — search term (required, min 2 characters). Owners/admins search every non-archived project in the org; others search public projects plus their own.

## Responses

**200 — array of matches** (max 20)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "12",
      "key": "PROJ-12",
      "title": "Fix login redirect loop",
      "type": "bug",
      "status": "in_progress",
      "priority": "high",
      "assignee": {
        "id": "a1b2...",
        "name": "Jane Doe",
        "email": "jane@example.com",
        "role_type": "user",
        "role_name": "Member",
        "initials": "JD"
      },
      "projectId": "7",
      "projectName": "Rai Web",
      "projectKey": "PROJ"
    }
  ],
  "error": ""
}
```
`assignee` is `null` when the ticket is unassigned.

**400 — query too short** (fewer than 2 characters)
```json
{ "success": false, "data": [], "error": "Query must be at least 2 characters" }
```

**401 — no or invalid token**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "Authentication required" }
```

**403 — no active org context**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": {}, "error": "No organization selected - switch into an org and retry" }
```

**500 — db error**
```json
{ "success": false, "data": [], "error": "Search failed" }
```
entries.curl:
```bash
curl "{{base_url}}/api/v1/search?q=login" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: {{org_id}}"
```

`q` must be at least 2 characters. Org context comes from the `X-Org-Id` header.
